snippet.title: Phantom Blade Zero - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Phantom Blade Zero brings the speed and spectacle of kungfu cinema to life in an epic journey through the world of Kungfupunk.

Get ready to draw your blade.

Pre-load: Oct 27, 10 am Beijing Time / Oct 26, 7 pm PT
Official game launch: Oct 29, 10 am Beijing Time / Oct 28, 7 pm PT

One more thing: the PS5 physical edition arrives in 2027! 

Thank you for your patience and for supporting us every step of the way. See you in the Wulin!

PRE-ORDER NOW:
PS5：https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/phantom-blade-zero/
Steam：https://store.steampowered.com/app/4115450/Phantom_Blade_Zero?utm_source=google&utm_campaign=preorder&utm_medium=organic&utm_content=pbzytb&utm_term=global
Epic：https://store.epicgames.com/p/phantom-blade-zero-e78a35
